abilities.name: CellEquipmentAbility1
abilities.description:
On activation:
Summon {1} $MiniBioinsect at this unit's position (Capacity: {2})
$MiniBioinsect will:
- Take {3}% of this unit's current damage as its own damage
- Have {4}% of this unit's current SPA
- Have {5}% of this unit's current range as its range
$MiniBioinsect is permanently in $CellTransformation1, and does not have passives or abilities.

abilities.name: CellEquipmentAbility2
abilities.description:
On activation:
- This unit will reset back to $CellTransformation1
- Permanently increase its own damage by {1}%
- Permanently increase its own range by {2}% (Capacity: {3}%)
